subject: note: Why not try and turn our selves inside out, away from the finally hateful inward suffering, and outwards and upwards towards others, not in the name of some right or duty, but out of love?
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
